Bug_Title: Unary prefix operators should not be repeated
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the lines where the unary prefix operators are repeated. The repetition of the operators invalidates the first one in most cases.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by using the methods `showBug` and `showBugBoolean` from the `UnaryBug` class. These methods contain the repeated unary prefix operators which is against the bug rule.
